answer: Under Regulation 1025/2012, European Standardisation Organisations (ESOs) must encourage broad participation in European standardisation, including by SMEs (Small and Medium-sized Enterprises), and provide free access to SMEs. Given the absence of AI-specific standards training, the Oxford Commission's Harmonising AI paper recommends that education and training specifically for non-expert AI stakeholders must be available to facilitate understanding of and participation in ESOs. This training should be tailored to a wide variety of stakeholder groups to develop the capacity and skills needed for effective participation in standards organisations.
